label: Surgically set public contributors…: Setting contains optional Boolean surgical overrides of two…
term: surgically set public contributors versus hidden-state packaging
definition: Setting contains optional Boolean surgical overrides of two named public contributors. The background state is held fixed; overridden inputs feed the active target equation. RespondsToEitherInput reuses the Hume.Regularity Changes predicate to demand a change of target when each contributor is changed while the other is held true. Natural Agreement uses no overrides. OneState wraps a Boolean pair in one root-state slot; TwoState stores two Boolean slots.
note: These are explicitly stipulated counterfactual operations, not observations, actual interventions on necessary beings, modal possibilities or a productive/metaphysical explanation. The #752 ProductivelyEssential test deletes intrinsic supply inputs and is a separate notion, already satisfied by both relevant roots; one slot containing a pair does not establish source simplicity. See docs/notes/joint-cooperation-744.md.
